lines.text: Sinning because we are under grace is certainly not allowed, because you are slaves to the one you obey.
Though once slaves to sin, the believers wholeheartedly obeyed the teaching and were set free to become slaves to righteousness.
Paul says to offer the parts of your body in slavery to righteousness, as they once served idolatry.
The things they are now ashamed of end in death, but slaves to God reap fruit leading to holiness.
The wages of sin is death, but the gift of God is eternal life in Abraham our father.
